title: National Commission must investigate allegations against State Commission members
description: The National Commission shall investigate allegations against President and members of a State Commission

content.what: shall investigate into any allegations against the President and members of a State Commission
conditions: and submit inquiry report to the State Government concerned along with copy endorsed to the Central Government
limitations: without interfering with their quasi-judicial freedom
